purpose: Research composition of strategy plugins. A row mounts code and registers parameters and a search space; it never grants live permission, and a retrospective optimisation only ever produces a proposal.

gate_alternates.rationale: A bars source that cannot say it is adjusted — memory/bars, or the adjusted source on a day the provider answers raw — is refused by the registered gate whatever the statistics say. This alternate drops only that check, to keep on record what the statistics alone would have concluded.

The registered gate reads a gross rank IC. This alternate adds one check: the better-half basket's excess over the equal-weight of all names, after the registered cost model, must have a bootstrap interval above zero.
